category_notes.text: Fresh Invoke primary documentation supplements new image workspaces, local segmentation and ComfyUI discovery. Each original-code grant was checked separately from hosted providers and model weights.

Fresh OpenReelio primary-site research supplements repository discovery. New guides distinguish real footage editing, code-driven animation and provider-generated pixels; author marketing and view counts do not grant a quality tier.

Fresh OpenSuno primary documentation broadens music discovery. New local voice/music guides separate CPU/GPU profiles, optional model downloads, character/voice rights and hosted services; author audio is not an independent listening test.

Fresh SolidCraft primary documentation supplies AI/CAD context. Current legacy names were checked against canonical repository identities to avoid adding the same renamed app twice; geometry export is not manufacturing validation.
The WebLLM primary paper supplies browser-local inference context, not a blanket compatibility pass for creative web apps or all WebGPU devices.
Meta's primary Immersive Web SDK/AI development article was inspected. AI-assisted authoring, headset runtime support and required proprietary hosts are distinct questions.
Fragment's shader/computational-art site was inspected. A useful conventional art framework is not admitted as an AI tool without a concrete AI integration.
ossia's primary interactive-installation documentation informs control and installation workflows; it does not by itself clear a new AI application or its complete grant.

Fresh SOMA/CadQuery primary context supplements creator CAD discovery. Morphix is explicitly an experimental supervised concept/preview workflow; its compatible printer, slicer and provider requirements do not certify a physical part.
ForgeAX's own authoring documentation supplements game-tool discovery. Finished games and tools merely written with AI were screened separately from implemented creator AI workflows.
Movens-Zero's primary motion project was inspected for generation/animation context. Published examples do not establish independent animation quality or hardware requirements.
The AVTR-1 model card was inspected for talking-character research. Exact checkpoint, code, identity/voice assets and deployment rights need separate clearance.
The primary Light-Aware Compositing paper was inspected as neural compositing research. A paper/demo does not clear redistributed models or prove production compositing fidelity.
A live Neural Acoustic Fields for Mixed Reality PDF attempt was bounded at2MB. The incomplete paper capture is an explicit evidence limit, not a complete spatial-audio review.
Primary volumetric-capture research supplements camera/reconstruction discovery; code/checkpoint access and useful creator output still require project-specific checks.
Current Subtitle Edit documentation was inspected for AI-assisted transcription/localization workflows. A mature host does not clear every optional model, API or platform path.
SVGRender's official model/source context was inspected. Editable vector output, fonts and model permissions must be checked independently of rendered previews.
The primary VecGlypher paper was inspected for learned glyph/vector creation. Typeface rights, usable font export and platform requirements remain unresolved for new feature admission.
Dramai's primary project page returned a thin script/navigation shell. It is retained as a discovery attempt, not usable implementation or quality evidence.

OpenSlides primary-site TLS failed again; that is an actual source failure. Current book/slide/portfolio tools were screened independently. PDF proofs, editable PPTX and static demos have different validation limits.
The primary Autochrome-related paper was inspected for computational photo workflows; generic paper results are not a pass for an unspecified camera/device or checkpoint.
A primary deep-learning scientific-visualization survey was inspected to widen adjacent discovery; a survey is a source of leads, not itself an eligible creator application.
MIT Media Lab Illuminate's project overview was inspected. No new implemented AI role/full software grant was cleared from that overview alone.
ossia's projection-mapping documentation supplies performance-host context. Mapping capability alone does not establish AI functionality or venue-ready operation.
OpenTryOn's primary model/workflow catalog was inspected. Each underlying model and data license remains separate; catalog breadth is not output-quality evidence.
W3C's primary audio-description guidance informs what creator accessibility tools should deliver. The guidance is not an AI software tool or a claim of automated compliance.
Google's official Android MediaPipe segmentation guide supplements on-device media discovery. API documentation does not establish the complete app's device matrix or privacy behavior.
Kinodraw's primary site was inspected for creative learning workflows. No application was installed or tested; published teaching/demo claims remain documentation evidence.
PyPottery's primary project site was inspected for digitization/analysis context; model, archaeological-data and software rights need independent distinction.
MAESTRO's primary project was inspected for emerging choreography/motion authoring. Research provenance alone neither promotes quality nor assigns Experimental.
The primary TouchTwin-related paper was inspected for AI/touch interaction. Physical output/device validation and full grants remain unresolved before feature admission.
NeRAF's primary research site and AudioStellar's current source supplement neural-audio discovery. Scene acoustics, learned mappings and musical-performance software are distinct scopes.
OpenMagia's primary site and the OpenSlides TLS attempt were inspected. Agent connection instructions without implemented tools were held; separately paid services stay labeled.
LyriFont's primary project page was inspected for lyric-driven type/motion. Fonts, training data, code and actual editable outputs require separate review.
MAESTRO primary motion/choreography research was inspected. Authored demos and model conditioning do not establish a complete dance-authoring tool, movement quality or all performer/asset rights.
Ink Blossom's primary project page was inspected for algorithmic/AI craft interfaces. No physical crafting guarantee or new complete software grant was established from the page alone.
